adjudication.K: held-out necessity lower 95% > 0 and sufficiency lower 95% >= 0.50 for both candidate metrics on validation and test
adjudication.compact_candidate_read_path: joint gate passes and union role cardinality <= 3
adjudication.joint: same conjunctive gate; only this earns candidate read path
adjudication.source_identity: exact positions reported descriptively beneath frozen roles

causal_ladder.current: GW-KEY-1 source-role causality through frozen L24H1
causal_ladder.successor: GW-READ-1 natural-Q cost and partial execution

claim: a frozen compact set of source roles is jointly necessary and sufficient, through L24H1, for held-out control-adjusted semantic alignment
claim_boundary: source K/V roles through frozen L24H1 only; natural final-position Q; not Q construction, correctness, cheap partial execution, an access primitive, or WALK

interventions.K: replace source K vectors before H1 scoring, then rerun real score scaling, softcap if declared, and softmax over every source position
interventions.V: hold the arm's routing weights fixed and replace source V vectors before weighted-V aggregation
interventions.downstream: effective prepared-production Q8 W_O, declared post-attention norm and residual write, then canonical L24 FFN and every later layer

families.K: selected roles natural K, other roles reference K; every V natural
families.V: every K natural; selected roles natural V, other roles reference V
families.joint: selected K roles and selected V roles natural; their complements reference

interventions.other_heads: all seven non-H1 query heads remain natural

reference_bank.direction: mean conditioned source vector from train rows only across every position in the cell
reference_bank.heldout: all train rows; no validation/test donor
reference_bank.scaling: scale each reference vector to the natural source-vector L2 norm

measurements.E: same-fact before-to-after gain minus matched different-fact gain; larger means more alignment
measurements.carrier: qualification only; cannot rescue either candidate metric
measurements.inherited: GW-HEAD-1 matched controls, 126 candidates, carrier cosine, raw candidate JS and z-scored candidate JS

question: which template-derived source roles causally supply L24H1 routing and content for the GW-HEAD-1 alignment effect?

roles.assignment: fixed template table; exhaustive, non-overlapping, outcome-blind
roles.empty_roles: allowed only for punctuation_separator and instruction_template; semantic roles subject_entity, relation_query, and answer_cue are always populated
roles.exact_positions: recorded beneath roles and never searched independently

search.compact: union of K and V selected roles has cardinality <= 3 of 6
search.eligibility: R(S) >= 0.80 independently for raw and z-scored candidate JS with positive E(I_full)
search.execution: direct H1 scoring/softmax/aggregation for every candidate; no summed singleton attribution
tie_break_joint: lexicographic K mask then V mask

site.source_window: all naturally attended prompt positions including the final position
